what: Prior-round fallback bound is ambiguous for round N greater than 2
scenario_or_breakage: Round 3 in flight without round-start-s and without a round-2 v1 row can fall back to round-1 end and re-include round-2 vendor rows
suggested_fix: Resolve prior-round end only from the v1 round row where round column equals round_num minus 1; if that row is absent use current round directory mtime never an older round end
